name: Brandstep
description: Step so that each foot leaves a glowing print the foe is reluctant to cross.

name: Hearthpalm
description: Touch the target with a palm warm as a hearth stone and grow it hotter as it presses.

name: Heathaze Turn
description: Hold a shimmering screen of heat on the open palm that bends a blow aside.

name: Brand Chain
description: Lay brands in a line on the foe's arm and chain them to one another with hot qi.

name: Melting Grasp
description: Grasp the guard hand so that its muscle softens in the heat and loses its form.

name: Glowing Pair
description: Strike with both palms together in a glowing pair that clamp the head of the target.

name: Palm Furnace
description: Fire the palm like a furnace door and press its heat into the foe until they cannot stand.

name: Branding Sweep
description: Sweep a glowing palm in an arc that leaves brands on every foe in reach.

name: Seared Verdict
description: Drive the whole heat of the palm into one point of the foe and sear through guard and flesh.

name: Searing Palm
description: The school's defining touch that brands the foe and melts the guard with a heat that grows with the user's reserve.

name: Azure Heat Step
description: Skim over the ground in a haze of azure heat that blurs the outline of the body.

name: Bluing Strike
description: Strike so the point of contact goes from red to blue with heat and melts into the target.

name: Azure Corona
description: Hold a halo of azure heat round the body that scorches any hand reaching in.

name: Steel Melt
description: Heat a foe's blade or armour past the point of tempering so it sags in their hold.

name: Sky Blaze
description: Throw a blaze of azure fire across the field that scorches the ground and the air.

name: Plate Slag
description: Hold a hot hand near armoured foes until their plate runs to slag and slows them.

name: Bluehot Spear
description: Thrust a spear of blue-hot magma qi through the guard to the body.

name: Melt Aura
description: Raise the heat of the whole field until stone softens and the ground drags at every foot.

name: Blue Inferno
description: Gather azure heat over several breaths and loose it as a roaring inferno across the front.

name: Skyward Magma
description: Hurl a mass of molten qi into the sky and let it fall in a glowing rain on chosen foes.

name: Meltdown Surge
description: Raise the field to a heat at which all steel and stone give way and run together.

name: Azure Magma
description: The school's central move that floods the field with azure-hot magma qi at a scale that grows with the user's reserve.

name: Coreward Step
description: Draw every step from the heat at the formed core and arrive in a glow of living stone.

name: Living Fist
description: Strike with a fist whose magma moves under the skin like a living thing.

name: Flow Skin
description: Let the surface of the body flow in a thin film of magma that carries blows away.

name: Crowning Heat
description: Pour the heat of the crown into a single blow that burns through the guard.

name: Magma Veins
description: Run veins of bright magma under the skin that harden into plate at the point of a blow.

name: Pour Sovereign
description: Pour a stream of crowned magma over the foe that cools into a heavy hold.

name: Spitting Core
description: Spit a clot of the core's own heat across the field at a single foe.

name: Regal Eruption
description: Raise the crown and let the core erupt through it in a column of living flame and stone.

name: Molten Mantle
description: Wear a mantle of live magma from the crown downward that parries blows and burns the striker.

name: Magma Sovereign
description: Command the molten crown and bring it down over the whole front in a rolling tide.

name: Living Crown
description: The apex move in which the user's crown of living magma rises and strikes in a measure that grows with the core.

name: Cinder Gust
description: Fan a gust of burning cinders from the palm onto the face of the target.

name: Carried Ember
description: Ride a gust like a carried ember across a pace of ground and land with a hot flare.

name: Cinderveil
description: Whirl a cloak of hot ash round the body that chokes and blinds those near.

name: Windfed Flare
description: Flare a spray of cinders on the wind so that every foe in front of the user is singed.

name: Smothering Smoke
description: Blow thick smoke over the foes so that eyes stream and the senses fail.

name: Kiln Updraft
description: Throw a hot updraft under the foe that lifts them off the ground and breaks their stance.

name: Spark Lash
description: Whip a long lash of sparking cinder across the foe's guard and into the face.

name: Cinder Wildfire
description: Scatter cinders ahead of the wind to rise in a spreading wildfire of molten flame.

name: Fanned Pyre
description: Fan the user's own heat on a rising gale and drive the full blaze against one foe.

name: Gale of Cinders
description: Summon a gale thick with white cinders that scours the field and burns whatever it touches.

name: Cinder Gale
description: The school's central move in which the gale and the burning cinders become one storm whose reach grows with reserve.

name: Gust Rider
description: Ride a gust forward on a thread of hot qi and drop into the foe's flank.

name: Lava Whip
description: Whip a rope of lava from the fist that wraps once about the target and burns.

name: Wind Skin
description: Run a skin of hot wind over the body that carries blows away from it.

name: Sworn Updraft
description: Throw a sworn updraft under the feet to leap clear above a sweep of blows.

name: Streaking Slag
description: Streak a line of slag through the air that lands as a burning splash on the target.

name: Draft Snare
description: Wrap the foe in a snare of hot wind and thin lava that cools as it tightens.

name: Lava Gale
description: Raise a gale thick with lava droplets and sweep it over a broad front of foes.

name: Windfire Lance
description: Spear a lance of lava down a tunnel of wind and run it through the guard.

name: Roaring Lava
description: Send sworn lava along the roar of the wind until it crashes over the whole field.

name: Sworn Magma
description: The school's defining move in which sworn lava rides every gust and strikes with a reach that grows with reserve.

name: Coalstep
description: Walk on glowing coals of qi that spring up under each foot and fade behind it.

name: Kindled Fist
description: Strike with a fist kindled at the core and burning steady from knuckle to wrist.

name: Banked Core
description: Bank the fire at the core and let a slow heat guard the whole body.

name: Core Bellows
description: Fan the core with a drawn breath so the fire in the body burns hotter for the next blows.

name: Undying Ember
description: Hold an undying ember at the heart of the guard that no blow can put out.

name: Coreblaze Surge
description: Surge the core's heat down the arm into one blow that scorches the target.

name: Sworn Fire
description: Set a ring of sworn fire about the foe that holds as long as the user keeps the oath.

name: Smelting Gaze
description: Fix a burning gaze on the foe so that their qi seems to melt and run slow.

name: Heart Furnace
description: Open the furnace of the heart and loose its whole fire in a ring about the user.

name: Fire Never Cooled
description: Hold the unquenched fire against all blows and answer each with a burning counter.

name: Core Unleashed
description: Break the last banking of the core and loose its fire in a single devouring burst.

name: Burning Oath
description: The apex move of the line in which the oath-bound fire of the core burns at a measure set by the user's core.
